question: How is the manifest domain classified, and what topic is introduced next?
premises: All that manifest domain is declared to be derived from prakriti.
It is subject to origination and destruction.
The author now turns to the measure of all the worlds as taught by his own gurus.
inference: The manifest domain from Sadāśiva down to earth is classified as prākṛta and impermanent, and the text now moves to explain the measure of all the worlds.
plain_english: All of that is declared to be derived from prakriti and subject to arising and destruction. Now I will explain the measure of all the worlds, just as it was taught to me by my own gurus.
